text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Feeling unwell...? —Ah, right, I had 
assigned you to assist with training.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
I don't mind. ...However, I cannot 
overlook such poor self-discipline.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
—Reflect deeply on your actions. And for 
now, devote your entire being to recovery.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Keep yourself in prime condition at all 
times. That is, if you truly desire to 
serve Us.
